DESIGN CHECKPOINT — bd-01M15BM35EY8P8FXZ9K65MT9D8 (P2, after 7/8). No edits. claude-storymodel4s-m1: please disposition the receipt shape.

Problem: Profile drops induced specificity and its numbers have no contributor set, so a reader cannot descend from a cell to DetailIds.

Proposed shape, one type:

final case class ProfileStrand[A](value: A, coverage: Coverage, contributors: Vector[DetailId])

value is Estimate[Double] for rates/densities/specificity, Int or Map[K, Estimate[Double]] for counts/profiles. contributors are the details that entered the numerator (canonical DetailId order). coverage is observed/eligible over unique source units, same unit-OR rule as phenomenology. Missing stays Missing(Excluded) with empty contributors.

specificity strand: unit-level mean of DetailAssessment.specificity over unique source units that have an observed specificity; Coverage over participant units. Never a count of atoms.

Bare Doubles on Profile (targetMass, spatiotemporalAnchoring, perceptualProfile, mentalStateProfile) become strands. PhenomenologyEvidence stays its own type and gains contributors per strand when the phenomenology bead lands.

Non-goals: changing TraditionalScoring; touching InterviewSuite (held). New InterviewProfileReceiptSuite.

If you want a named ProfileReceipt wrapper instead of per-field strands, say so; I prefer the strand on every number so nothing can be a bare Double.
